## Express-Idea Vocabulary

**Sequencing/chain-handovers:** "Gather… and put on" / "Then pour… 30ml each pot for the fourth row" (arithmetic dose ladder via "Then" + comma chain) / "Add… prior to [next stage]" (temporal anchor) / "Continue… until… has completely…" (duration anchor) / "Repeat the process of [verb]-ing" (repetition framing) / "Repeat Steps 1–4 9 more times" (replication directive) / "Repeat Steps 1–5 for the remaining independent variable conditions" (IV cascade)

**Specification/quantification:** "should be equal to one cup" / "Each cup should have one teaspoon" / "at 17 psi" / "at room temperature (15-30 C)" / "1M HCl" / "in the center of the pot" / colon "Set the wavelength: 635 nm" / reagent volumes + concentrations / "controlled using a stopwatch (±0.05s)" (precision clause) / "measure the absorbance at the wavelength of 635nm" (named wavelength) / ± tolerance / parenthetical units / provider credential

**Cause/mechanism/condition:** "If [failure] does not [verb] then [reagent] and mix, heat, and rotate until [outcome] becomes [adj]" / "…until the powder has completely dissolved" (completion trigger) / "to ease the breakdown of cellular components and release the remaining iodine" (purpose-of-action clause embedded in action) / "as/since [reason]" / semicolon "Transfer …; use it to calibrate …"

**Instruction verbs:** Gather, put on, Tie up, Label, Place, Take, add, Rinse, Continue stirring, Dispense, pressure cook, Pour, Mix, Plant, water, observe, Measure, discard, Connect, Set, Transfer, Insert, initiate, Repeat, Blend, Agitate, Decant, Strain, Pipette, Vortex

**Standardisation:** "Plant 1 seed per pot" (fixed density)

**Procedural close:** "Safely discard and clean up lab materials" / "Transfer blended samples into separate beaker and label '[Name]'"

**Referential continuity:** "the solution" / "each pot" / "the specimen" / "from Step 2b" — backward-pointing nouns chain sentences without transition words

**Tool substitution:** "…and/or … can be used"

**Enumeration/specification:** "sundaes, shakes, cookies, waffles, and brownies" (comma-then-final-and list) / "We sell the brownies in bulk to another local café who sell it at their outlets" (B2B channel flag)

**Logical-argument vocabulary**

| Token | Job |
|---|---|
| “Note that” | Opens caveat / data-quality footnote |
| “n/a” | Inline absence marker |
| “Finally,” / “Lastly,” / “In addition,” | Closing-position sequencer |
| “However” | Concession/contrast |
| “Therefore” / “∴” | Verdict marker |
| “This suggests that” | Translates number to subject-language |
| “Conclusively” | One-line labelled finding |
| “For example” | Single real-world instance |
| “Considering H[x]” | Rolls finding back into research question |
| “may simply be due to” | Hedged methodological cause |
| “will not be included in any further calculations” | Boundary on datum flow |
| “to align with the uncertainty of” | Ties display choice to instrument resolution |
| “Full values were used in all calculations” | Contrasts displayed vs worked precision |
